name: Eco Machina Allocation Fix
description: Compat patch for Eco Machina 0.6.x. Stops the render-only tapered wood mesh append path from reallocating whole mesh pool buffers (Int32[] on the large object heap) on every insertion: pool buffers now grow geometrically and the per-insert custom data placeholder is sized to the inserted mesh instead of the whole pool. Behavior is otherwise unchanged. Client side only.
